## free-tier-llm-landscape

- **What matters:** I cannot verify changes through 2026-10-04; free quotas, supported model IDs, and terms can change without notice.
- **Why it matters:** Rate limits, regional restrictions, queueing, and data-use rules can break agent loops or invalidate privacy assumptions across Groq, Together, OpenRouter, Gemini, and Hugging Face.
- **Verify:** Check each provider’s current quotas, reset windows, model availability, rate-limit headers, and data-retention terms; configure fail-closed behavior and spending caps.

## agent-safety-practice

- **What matters:** Allow read-only operations automatically; permit sandboxed writes; require approval for secrets, network access, publishing, deployment, and destructive actions.
- **Why it matters:** Repository content is untrusted and may contain prompt injection, so least privilege, ephemeral isolation, restricted egress, and scoped credentials limit blast radius.
- **Verify:** Test injected instructions and confirm audit logs capture prompts, tool arguments, approvals, outputs, diffs, tests, and commit identifiers without leaking secrets.
